key_insight: CoilStellaration benchmarks AI-generated stellarator coils against magnetic-field and engineering requirements, with learned predictions showing promise as optimization starting points.
engineering_relevance: The benchmark connects coil generation to spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field constraints relevant to practical stellarator design.
method: Compile 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting ConStellaration plasma equilibria.
Condition coil predictions on target equilibria and sampled engineering requirements across multiple coil counts and field-period numbers.
Evaluate direct coil generation and learned initializations for conventional coil optimization.
evidence_signal: Evaluated learned models rarely satisfy all requirements simultaneously, but their predictions can accelerate early progress in conventional optimization.
watch_item: Magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge; filamentary-coil results do not establish manufacturing readiness.
paper_title: CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
